subject.title: fix(pairing): preserve authorized senders when allowFrom reads fail

question: Should this PR be narrowed/rebased to the pairing-only fail-closed fix before merge, or should maintainers intentionally review and accept the broad current-head dependency/workflow/generated drift too?
rationale: The central pairing fix is well supported, but the live head is dirty and includes unrelated security- and automation-sensitive surfaces that ClawSweeper should not treat as implicitly approved.

options.title: Rebase to pairing-only and land
options.body: Recreate the head from current main with only the pairing source/tests, rerun focused proof, and then land the accepted fail-closed behavior.

options.title: Review the broad head intentionally
options.body: Treat the dependency, workflow, native i18n, docs, app, and runtime changes as in scope and require owner/security review for all of them before merge.

options.title: Replace this branch
options.body: If the current branch cannot be narrowed cleanly, close or pause it and open a fresh PR carrying the pairing fix only.

recommendation.title: Rebase to pairing-only and land
recommendation.body: Recreate the head from current main with only the pairing source/tests, rerun focused proof, and then land the accepted fail-closed behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the replacement branch and has the strongest pairing-area history for deciding whether to narrow or accept the current head.
